decisions.reason: After two years without website presence, the initial home-page commitment to this close-to-core line no longer outweighs the ease of reallocating effort to stronger established candle-arch products.

Although it fits the firm's traditional pyramid business, its absence from the site in 2020 and 2021 suggests management can now treat it as a replaceable variant rather than a commitment that still needs defending.

Even with the earlier flagship status and sunk investment, two years of non-observation make a temporary setback hard to justify, so management would now be likely to end this distant electronic line.
This low-visibility accessory was mainly justified by the flagship electronic music box, so once that line no longer appears, it becomes one of the easiest products to cut.
As a niche accessory tied to the unobserved electronic music-box concept, it has little standalone reason to survive and is very likely to be withdrawn.
Its thematic fit with the firm's craft tradition argues for patience, but after two years off the website management would probably free capacity for better-performing core seasonal pieces instead.
